description_en: large shallow sericulture display tray with woven bamboo base and divided empty radial channels; front low rim, right side bound frame, rear two reinforcing bamboo runners
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the canonical FRONT. Render ONE photorealistic RIGHT-SIDE azimuth90, exact profile of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating only the camera. Same circular flat radial tray, camera from right at modest elevation. Keep six radial sections and center ring; no new legs. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
